_about: Owner: writer B5a (model map, MLA attention, sparse-attention indexer; code pages deepseek.py, attn.py, mla_attn.py, index_attn.py).

mla.short: Multi-head Latent Attention. Many query heads read one small latent vector per token. In DeepInfer this 512-value vector is both the key and the value.

mqa.short: Multi-query attention: all query heads share one key head and one value head. The KV cache then stores one entry per token, not one per head.
mqa.long: DeepInfer's main attention is MQA over the latent vector (num_key_value_heads == 1, {{cite deepinfer/model_executor/models/v4_modules/mla_attn.py:175-176}}). The indexer class is also named MQA ({{cite deepinfer/model_executor/models/v4_modules/index_attn.py:56}}).

latent-kv.short: The one vector per token that MLA keeps instead of separate keys and values. In DeepInfer it has 512 values: kv_lora_rank values without position, then qk_rope_head_dim values with RoPE.

low-rank-projection.short: Two small matrices in place of one large one: A maps the input down to rank r, and B maps it back up. It uses fewer weights. The code calls it LoRA (Wq.A, Wq.B).

rope.short: Rotary position embedding. It turns pairs of values by an angle that depends on the token position, so the score q·k depends on the distance between the two tokens.

rmsnorm.short: A normalization layer: it divides a vector by the root mean square of its values, then multiplies each value by a learned weight.

attention-sink.short: One learned score per attention head that takes part in the softmax but has no value vector. A head can give part of its attention to it, that is, to nothing.

sparse-attention.short: Attention in which each query reads only a selected set of keys, not all earlier keys. The work per query then has a fixed upper limit.

sparse-indexer.short: A small, cheap scorer that chooses which compressed keys each query reads in sparse attention. In DeepInfer it is the class MQA in index_attn.py.

top-k-selection.short: Keep the k largest scores of a row and return their positions. The indexer uses it to choose keys; DeepInfer calls the DeepSelect kernel topk.

compress-ratio.short: kv_compress_ratio of a layer: 0 means the layer has only sliding-window KV, 1 (C1) one compressed entry per token, 2 (C2) one entry per 2 tokens.

decoder-layer.short: One of the N repeated blocks of the model. In DeepInfer each one runs attention, then MoE, with mHC mixing around both (class DeepseekDecoderLayer).

embedding.short: A table with one row of hidden_size numbers for each token id. The model starts by reading the row of each input token.

lm-head.short: The last matrix of the model, [vocab_size, hidden_size]. It turns a hidden state into one logit per token id.

flashmla.short: DeepSeek's attention-kernel library (vendor/FlashMLA). DeepInfer calls its sparse prefill and decode kernels through layers/attention_backend.py.

deepselect.short: DeepSeek's top-k kernel library (vendor/DeepSelect). The indexer calls deep_select.interface.topk to choose keys.

deepgemm.short: DeepSeek's matrix-multiply kernel library (vendor/DeepGEMM). The indexer uses its FP8/FP4 MQA-logits kernels; attention uses its fp8_einsum.
